development: 30 complementary V scenes not used to select the first LR mixture; 15 per camera
selection: Both camera means: PSNR >= existing balanced V1.5 -0.03 dB; LPIPS <= existing V1.5; lower amplitude error. Prefer minimum pooled LPIPS. Matched retrieval, wrong keys/values, direct interpolation at fixed phase fraction on all panels even if validation selects identity.
new_test: Same V1.5 E and two fixed T panels excluded from A8 training; additional test with a fresh seed 37 using DRealSR V, without evaluation-time retuning.
